title: Continuing education credit for instructors and postgraduate curricula
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 4.07 a registered pharmacist who is a Board-approved continuing education instructor receives continuing education credit for the program taught on a one-time basis annually. Under 247 CMR 4.08 a registered pharmacist who enrols in a postgraduate pharmacy curriculum, postgraduate pharmacy program or Board-approved postgraduate medical program shall be awarded contact hours for satisfactory completion of each course within that curriculum, provided the sponsor or co-sponsor is a Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited provider and the course provides instruction in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.
exam_relevance: Tests two alternative credit routes and the conditions that limit them, including the once-a-year cap on credit for teaching.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Teaching the same program repeatedly yields credit only once annually.
Postgraduate course credit requires both an authorized sponsor and a qualifying subject area.
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 4.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-B authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
